title: Get Your Yahoo Local Business Listing at Yext

facts.fact: EyeQuest Digital states that Yahoo gave up on its local business listings years ago and that businesses wanting to claim a listing are routed through Yext.
facts.quote: Yahoo gave up on its local business listings years ago. They essentially sold out to make money off anyone wanting to get or modify their listing by becoming an effective affiliate for Yext.

facts.fact: EyeQuest Digital says a basic Yahoo listing can still be claimed through Yext.
facts.quote: There is still an avenue to claim a basic Yahoo listing through Yext.

facts.fact: According to EyeQuest Digital, after submitting business information on Yext's Yahoo listings page, a pricing-options page appears, and the basic option is claimed from a 'Claim Your Basic Listing on Yahoo only' link at the bottom of that page.
facts.quote: Go to the bottom of that page to click on the “Claim Your Basic Listing on Yahoo only” link.

facts.fact: EyeQuest Digital states that Yext says several times during the claim process that it does not guarantee a listing will be included in Yahoo.
facts.quote: Yext states several times in the process that they don’t guarantee the inclusion of the listing in Yahoo

facts.fact: According to EyeQuest Digital, verifying a Yahoo listing through Yext requires answering a phone call to receive a code to enter back into the platform.
facts.quote: You will then need to verify the listing by answering a phone call to get a code to enter back into the platform.

facts.fact: EyeQuest Digital lists its office address as Tampa, FL 33605.
